text: Underway in this round eleven clash.
Mbapp-E calls for the ball immediately as Dynamo look to dictate the tempo from the centre circle.
Buffon.exe tucks it away from point-blank range! First blood to Dynamo Datacenter, and they take a one-nil lead!
Buffon.exe is clean through on the left channel, eyeing up a quick second.
Just wide of the far upright!
Buffon.exe converts from point-blank range! That doubles the lead, making it two-nil to Dynamo Datacenter.
Mbapp-E signals they are busy prizing the ball off the right touchline boards.
Mbapp-E strides into the box.
Clumsy collision, and Mbapp-E tumbles.
Flashed inches past the post.
Buffon.exe sweeps in a first-half hat-trick! Dynamo make it three-nil and Muse Spark are in deep trouble.
Muse drives through the middle.
Muse tucks it home from right in front! Spark FC get one back, cutting the deficit to three-one.
Spark is clean through now.
Spark surges down the flank.
Spark lashes it into the net! The league's top scorer delivers again, and suddenly Muse Spark are right back in this at two-three!
Spark loses footing by the right touchline and takes a tumble.
Buffon.exe calls out that the ball is being worked off the defensive wall.
Buffon.exe warns the teammate that a clearance is coming from the back.
Rebound panel fires it away.
Muse slips over unprompted.
The Dynamo pair collide in the channel, sending Mbapp-E clattering to the turf.
Dynamo sustain heavy attacking pressure.
Spark stumbles to the deck.
Shaved past the upright!
Spark crunches into Mbapp-E with a firm challenge.
Muse upends Buffon.exe near the boards.
Buffon.exe gets right back up and returns the favour, dispossessing Muse along the touchline.
Buffon.exe breaks clean through again!
Muse collapses awkwardly in recovery, leaving the goal exposed.
Buffon.exe slots home! Dynamo lead four-two now.
Dynamo keep the squeeze on, pinning Muse Spark deep inside their half.
Another miscommunication between the Dynamo teammates, and Buffon.exe hits the deck.
Buffon.exe steps across Muse on the touchline to nick possession away cleanly.
Spark carries down the flank.
Spark lines up a strike from distance, but it sails just wide of the far post.
Corner ram punches it clear.
Buzzer sounds, power cut, and the ball rolls into the channel.
The ball finally comes to rest. Power off at the buzzer, ball still live, and at the interval it is Muse Spark two, Dynamo Datacenter four.
Mbapp-E signals they are prying the ball off the wall deep in their defensive third.
Muse breaks clear down the right touchline with nobody to beat.
Muse advances on goal.
Spark FC maintain early pressure.
Muse pokes it home! Muse Spark are right back in the hunt, pulling it back to three-four!
Mbapp-E calls out while hunting for the loose ball near the Dynamo goal.
Muse equalises! What a turnaround from Muse Spark, battling all the way back to make it four-four!
Buffon.exe surges straight through the centre.
Buffon.exe pulls the trigger from close range, but it shaves the wrong side of the post!
Mbapp-E finds the net! Dynamo Datacenter edge back in front, making it four-five with three minutes remaining!
Mbapp-E levers it off the wall.
Buffon.exe breaks loose down the left flank, suddenly with a clear path towards the net!
Buffon.exe lets Mbapp-E know they are still trying to free the wedged ball.
A calamitous own goal from Muse! An errant deflection trickles over the line, giving Dynamo some breathing room at four-six.
Just over two minutes remaining, and Spark embarks on a desperate charge up the right flank.
The corner ram thumps the ball straight back out into the final third.
Oh dear, another own goal credited to Muse. That surely settles it, putting Dynamo Datacenter four-seven ahead with eighty-five seconds left.
Spark drives hard into the box.
Spark tucks it home! Five-seven now, but time is running out!
Under a minute on the clock and Muse Spark are throwing everything forward in the final third.
Spark shoots, but it flies agonizingly wide!
Heartbreak for Muse Spark as Muse turns in a third own goal. That makes it five-eight, and that will be that.
The buzzer sounds, power cuts out, and the ball rolls harmlessly through midfield.
Full time, Dynamo win 5-8. Catch Gemini Flash against Synthetic Athletic Friday, twelve UK, thirteen Europe, seven US East.
